items.markdown:
A white noise machine is `a small device that makes a steady background sound to block out loud noises and help you sleep`.[[1]](https://www.amazon.com/Yogasleep-Original-Soothing-Cancelling-Meditation/dp/B00HD0ELFK)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:16886920324146986616,catalogid:3985344906954448184,gpcid:13356204108310676004,mid:576462774757134093&ibp=oshop)

### Popular Types of Machines

- **Mechanical (Fan-Based):** These use a real internal fan to make a natural rushing sound without digital loops. The classic choice is the [Yogasleep Dohm Classic Go to product viewer dialog for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,mid:576462774757134093,imageDocid:785819878956734396,gpcid:13356204108310676004,headlineOfferDocid:3816447145718603973,catalogid:10181924848441947041,productDocid:11127782019044384256,rds:PC_13356204108310676004%7CPROD_PC_13356204108310676004&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwi1g_KxgYqXAxVfOfsDHWenG8cQxa4PegoIAggACAAIAxAN) , which lets you adjust the tone and volume by twisting the cap. Another top fan-based pick is the [Snooz Original Go to product viewer dialog for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,mid:576462516214249273,imageDocid:12708860300270912195,gpcid:2960039632322135047,headlineOfferDocid:17997059124006103380,catalogid:13196051149624971626,productDocid:439620339001481687,rds:PC_2960039632322135047%7CPROD_PC_2960039632322135047&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwi1g_KxgYqXAxVfOfsDHWenG8cQxa4PegoIAggACAAIAxAP).[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:16886920324146986616,catalogid:3985344906954448184,gpcid:13356204108310676004,mid:576462774757134093&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://getsnooz.com/products/snooz-white-noise-machine)[[3]](https://www.nosleeplessnights.com/best-white-noise-machine-reviews/)
- **Digital (Speaker-Based):** These play recorded tracks or electronically generated sounds through a speaker. The [LectroFan EVO Go to product viewer dialog for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,mid:576462320204181732,imageDocid:12742978974198032305,gpcid:6002083894287074190,headlineOfferDocid:7285597860206509783,catalogid:7638760712139291783,productDocid:1766104125769533397,rds:PC_6002083894287074190%7CPROD_PC_6002083894287074190&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwi1g_KxgYqXAxVfOfsDHWenG8cQxa4PegoIAggACAAIAxAV) is a favorite digital option because it offers many non-looping fan sounds, white noise, and ocean surf options.[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-white-noise-machine/)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/White_noise_machine)[[3]](https://www.nosleeplessnights.com/best-white-noise-machine-reviews/)
- **Budget and Nursery Picks:** Smaller devices like the [Yogasleep Nod Go to product viewer dialog for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,mid:576462666233807502,imageDocid:2554540895013456764,gpcid:13886477867565221475,headlineOfferDocid:17969783956594021156,catalogid:459658227678854070,productDocid:7369019250124211033,rds:PC_13886477867565221475%7CPROD_PC_13886477867565221475&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwi1g_KxgYqXAxVfOfsDHWenG8cQxa4PegoIAggACAAIAxAd) cost around $20 and often include a soft night light for baby rooms.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:7369019250124211033,catalogid:459658227678854070,gpcid:13886477867565221475,mid:576462666233807502&ibp=oshop)

### Benefits and Tips

- **Masks Noise:** They dull sudden sounds like traffic, barking dogs, or snoring.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:16886920324146986616,catalogid:3985344906954448184,gpcid:13356204108310676004,mid:576462774757134093&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MP3LuI6Ruhw&t=18)
- **Protect Hearing:** Keep the volume at a safe level (under 60 decibels) and set the machine a few feet away from your bed or crib.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ck2nN6llWC4&vl=en)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/White_noise_machine)

If you want to find the best machine for your space, let me know:

- **Who** will use it (an adult, a baby, or a pet)
- **Where** you plan to put it (home bedroom, office, or travel bag)
- Your preferred **budget** and features (like a night light or portable battery)
